`/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/tools/mado-launchenv.py` (target path; the in-wave draft is /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-99/build/mado-launchenv.py, owned by R99MExecTool):

```

```

It models GIO 2.90.1's launch spawn environment for one desktop file and a list of arguments. It
loads the committed `tools/mado-execargv.py` by path (importlib, sibling file, never modified) for
the argv expansion and adds five rules: the load gate (R1), the terminal prepend (R2), the
post-prepend `argv[0]` lookup (R3), the cwd (R4) and `GIO_LAUNCHED_DESKTOP_FILE` (R5), over

```
MADO_LAUNCHENV: launches=N terminal=<name|-> cwd=<escaped path|->
LAUNCH k: argc=M terminal=<name|->
ARGV[k][i]=<escaped>
ENV[k] GIO_LAUNCHED_DESKTOP_FILE=<escaped path|->
```

exit 0 on success; 2 on a refusal with one line `MADO_LAUNCHENV: ERROR <cause> detail=<...>`
(causes: `load` - the load-gate program lookup fails; `no-terminal`; `program-not-found`; and the
round-98 causes `no-exec`, `desktop-file`, `exec-parse` passed through). `--json` prints one object

`{"error":"<cause>","detail":"..."}`. `--selftest` prints

## Shared contract 2 - the C1 oracle and case file

`/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-99/controls/launchenv-probe-r99.py` (R99MExecOracle) materialises a case root and measures it

  with a 10 s timeout and a 1.5 s quiet wait for the child, and reads `<root>/out`.
- the probe records `ARGV0=$0`, `ARGC=$#`, `A<i>=<arg>`, `CWD=<pwd>`, `GDF=<GIO_LAUNCHED_DESKTOP_FILE>`
  one record per spawn, appended atomically (`>>` with a single printf per line, flock-free).
- `expect` is `{"launches":N,"argv":[[...]],"cwd":...,"env_gdf":...}` or `{"error":"<cause>"}` where
  the cause is derived from `gio`'s exit status and stderr text (`Unable to load application
  information` -> `load`, `Unable to find terminal required` -> `no-terminal`, `not found in $PATH`
  -> `program-not-found`).
- the case file `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-99/controls/launchenv-cases-r99.json` carries >=16 classes and >=60 cases, each
  label measured twice with agreeing results; the fresh generator
